description: An unencrypted Android adb backup's app data (header versions 1 to 5), laid out as ALEAPP reads it and then parsed by ALEAPP: the backup's apps/<package>/<domain>/... members are mapped onto data/data/<package>/... (a table of the FullBackup tree tokens that is the author's recollection of AOSP's constants and has not been checked against the source), and ALEAPP's artefact modules run over that layout with -t fs and write a TSV report per artefact that has records, a timeline database and an HTML report. The result is a derivative of an adb backup, never a file-system acquisition: derivative/DERIVATIVE.json and coverage.json say so. An encrypted backup (AES-256) is refused as failed and no password is read. The run says complete only when the layout was made from a payload read to the end of its zlib stream, the tar's two end blocks came with nothing after them, every member laid out by design was written, and the ALEAPP receipt is as android-aleapp's (modules.tsv).
exclusions: what the mapping does not lay out: the APK, obb, external storage files, shared/, links, devices, FIFOs, directories, unknown domains and rejected member names (each listed in ab-members.tsv)
artefacts no module of the pinned ALEAPP release parses: their files stay in the layout, unread by this extraction
deleted records beyond what a module reads itself (SQLite free pages, WAL): nothing is carved
an encrypted backup: it is refused, and no password is read
a module the log does not account for as completed (errored, or started and not finished): see modules.tsv
covers: What the mapping lays out of the backup's apps (see ab-members.tsv for every member and its state) and what ALEAPP's modules parse from that layout: one TSV per artefact that has records, its timeline and every file it wrote, kept under aleapp/, and modules.tsv with the outcome of each module its log names. It is a derivative of an adb backup, not the phone's file system, and the mapping table behind it has not been checked against the AOSP source. A module that finds nothing writes no report (no_record), which does not show the artefact never existed; a module that errored or whose end the log does not show is not covered. The program is run in this recipe's process group with the time that is left of its limit (--max-seconds, default 14100 seconds, less the time the layout took; at least one second): one that does not finish is ended with everything it started, what it wrote is kept, and the run says partial or failed, never complete; a stop signal ends it and its children before the recipe ends. The layout and the report contain the phone's own content and are a sensitive output.  A process that ALEAPP left running after it exited (one that holds a file the tool keeps, in the tool's process group or in a session of its own, or one that holds no descriptor and writes by name) is stopped, killed and reaped by the shared process block's settle() before the reports, the logs and the files are counted and read; one found, or a host where the absence of one cannot be proven (not Linux, PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER refused), makes the run partial (coverage.json and the printed line carry program_group, and the status basis says why), and the reports are then what the leftover had written when it was ended. A refusal carries no program_group. A process that is no descendant of the program (started through a service manager) is not found.
